blurb: Balanced Bodies offers therapeutic bodywork, craniosacral therapy, massage, and wellness services at two locations: Charlottesville Wellness Studios and the Flower of Life Sanctuary in the Blue Ridge Mountains. Services include massage therapy, craniosacral therapy, lymphatic massage, Reiki, infant therapy, and restorative experiences such as yoga and sound healing.
extraNote: Free client consultation available · Charlottesville Wellness Studios at 1110 Rose Hill Dr or Flower of Life Sanctuary at 2218 Lake Albemarle Dr
